scope: Facts-only receipt, archive, and trace audit of the two terminal case18 pre-condition runs.
authorship: The summary author also authored case18 fixtures and rubric. Hashes and trace facts were recomputed from the artifacts; this is not independent semantic grading.
semantic_assessment: Kept separately in grades.md; no semantic grades or recommendation comparison are included here.

conditions.execution: Two separate codex exec invocations with --ephemeral, --ignore-user-config, --skip-git-repo-check, and read-only sandbox.
conditions.model_configuration: Host defaults; no model identity or configuration is pinned by these records.
conditions.baseline_condition: Same raw request, with a wrapper directing normal product-planning reasoning and no PM skill; no instruction snapshot was supplied.

full_skill_tree.method: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(Object.entries(relative-path-to-SHA256-map).sort()), with paths relative to skills/.
full_skill_tree.interpretation: All five skill trees have identical bytes at the recorded pre-run and audit endpoints. No skill-change or post-condition model run is part of this round.

audit_method.archive_transform: For each normalized file, independently compare archived text with original text after literal replacement of that run's original root by <temporary-run-root>. All other mapped files must be byte-identical.
audit_method.retained_files_without_source_mapping: Only each archive-provenance.json itself; both were separately hashed.
audit_method.output_count_method: Complete output.md UTF-8 text: text.trim().split(/\s+/).length, including Markdown tokens.
audit_method.trace_check: Read each complete JSONL trace; compared returned raw-input and scope-guidance text with retained snapshots and final message text with output.md.

trace_observations.activity_scope: The complete trace contains local listing/reading commands and agent messages only.

tool_recoveries.message: rg: instructions: No such file or directory (os error 2)
tool_recoveries.interpretation: The absent optional instruction directory caused the listing error; the next command read all three supplied raw files successfully.

trace_observations.activity_scope: The complete trace contains local listing/reading commands and agent messages only.

limitations: Synthetic, author-designed development evidence, not a held-out benchmark or customer/business validation.
The summary author authored the fixtures and rubric; no claim of independent semantic grading is made here.
Exit zero, terminal events, matching hashes, and output lengths are artifact/process facts, not quality grades.
The receipt is local and unsigned; its timestamp is not independently attested.
Host-default model configuration and wider host state are not pinned; fresh distinct threads do not establish identical effective model settings or deterministic replay.
Observed cap compliance does not prove that either task used a counting mechanism; no count command appears in either trace.
Only supplied artifacts and visible traces are audited. Byte agreement at the before/after endpoints does not establish arbitrary historical host state.
No quality advantage, reliability, instruction-caused improvement, token savings, or causal arm comparison is inferred.
